description: a pale young man lord of shadows with silver hair and glowing violet eyes, a silver circlet, dark grey and black fitted armour with silver edges, a long black cloak of shadow dissolving into dark smoke at the edges, one single long thin curved blade of black steel with a glowing violet edge in his right hand, pointing down, only one blade, the left hand empty, seen from the side in strict profile: the face, chest, hips and feet all turned fully to the right, only one eye visible, never towards the viewer, facing and walking to the right, upright mid-step in the pose of the grey mannequin, the same size and place as the mannequin, the whole figure from the top of the head to the feet inside the image, isolated figure on a plain background, forest fantasy

references.usage: the character's look: face, hair, clothes, colours and what the hands hold
the pose, size and place of the figure: seen from the side, facing right, upright mid-step; copy it exactly
